def process(topTenCategories) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = topTenCategories.copy()

    # The file appears to have a title row, then a true header row at index 1.
    # Re-construct with the real header.
    header = df.iloc[1].tolist()
    data = df.iloc[2:].copy()
    data.columns = header

    # Drop blank/title/source rows
    data = data.dropna(how='all')

    # Standardize column names
    data = data.rename(columns={
        'State': 'state',
        'Category': 'category',
        '# of Reports': 'numReports',
        'Percentage': 'percentage'
    })

    # Keep only expected columns if present
    keep = [c for c in ['state', 'category', 'numReports', 'percentage'] if c in data.columns]
    data = data[keep]

    # Clean strings
    for c in ['state', 'category']:
        if c in data.columns:
            data[c] = data[c].astype(str).str.strip()
            data.loc[data[c].isin(['nan', 'None', '']), c] = pd.NA

    data = data.dropna(subset=['state', 'category'])

    return data.reset_index(drop=True)

def process(cleanTopTenCategories) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = cleanTopTenCategories.copy()

    target = "Prizes, Sweepstakes and Lotteries"
    mask = df["category"].astype(str).str.strip().eq(target)

    states = (
        df.loc[mask, "state"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .replace({"": pd.NA})
        .dropna()
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values()
    )

    return pd.DataFrame({"stateCount": [int(states.shape[0])]})
